notes: Historical EBIT is proxied by EPAM’s “Income from operations” (GAAP) from the consolidated statements of income; D&A is proxied by “Depreciation and amortization expense”; capex is proxied by “Purchases of property and equipment.” ([s202.q4cdn.com](https://s202.q4cdn.com/436759741/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/10k-2025.pdf))

NWC construction (for 2023-2025) is: NWC = (Total current assets - Cash and cash equivalents) - Total current liabilities, using balance sheet current asset/liability totals. This includes any restricted cash embedded in current assets and omits any distinction between cash vs restricted cash at the NWC level. ([s202.q4cdn.com](https://s202.q4cdn.com/436759741/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/10k-2025.pdf))

Tax rate uses management guidance for 2026 GAAP effective tax rate (~26%) rather than a long-run average. ([investors.epam.com](https://investors.epam.com/news/news-details/2026/EPAM-Reports-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025/default.aspx))

WACC is taken from StockAnalysis as a proxy (model-based); it may differ from a primary-source CAPM-based WACC built internally. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/epam/statistics/?utm_source=openai))

NOL utilization is not explicitly disclosed as a utilization percent in EPAM’s filings; nol_utilization_pct is therefore a modeling assumption (0.80) applied to the NOL balance. ([s202.q4cdn.com](https://s202.q4cdn.com/436759741/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/10k-2025.pdf))

catalysts: Beat/raise versus the 2026 revenue growth and operating margin ranges, indicating continued AI-led demand capture and delivery productivity. ([investors.epam.com](https://investors.epam.com/news/news-details/2026/EPAM-Reports-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025/default.aspx))
Sustained working-capital efficiency that converts reported earnings into free cash flow above modeled steady-state utilization.
Execution of acquisitions and integration into the global delivery model to expand vertical depth without major margin dilution.
company_overview: Global digital engineering and AI transformation services provider delivering custom software, product/platform engineering, and integrated consulting.
Uses a global delivery model spanning the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, with diversified vertical exposure and scaling from shared fixed-cost resources.
Primarily monetizes via professional services (with a small licensing/other component) under contract-based revenue recognition.
current_context: 2026 outlook guides revenue growth of 4.5% to 7.5% (GAAP) and GAAP operating income at 10% to 11% of revenue; non-GAAP operating income is guided at 15% to 16%. ([investors.epam.com](https://investors.epam.com/news/news-details/2026/EPAM-Reports-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025/default.aspx))

Guidance also frames GAAP effective tax rate around ~26% for 2026. ([investors.epam.com](https://investors.epam.com/news/news-details/2026/EPAM-Reports-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025/default.aspx))

Strong liquidity profile: cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash totaled $1.301 billion at Dec. 31, 2025. ([investors.epam.com](https://investors.epam.com/news/news-details/2026/EPAM-Reports-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025/default.aspx))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth chains to management’s 2026 guidance range and gradually normalizes to mid-single-digits as the delivery footprint scales.
Margin thesis: operating leverage and cost discipline support EBIT margins recovering toward the low-to-mid teens over the forecast horizon.
Capital intensity remains low (capex typically well under 1% of sales), supporting durable free cash generation capacity versus revenue growth.
Working-capital intensity is modeled as normalizing from the 2025 level toward a steadier long-run utilization, limiting downside to cash conversion.
key_risks: Client discretionary spend delays or project ramp-downs reducing growth below the base-case trajectory.

Margin pressure from compensation inflation, delivery mix, or unfavorable FX/hedging impacts on revenue and operating expenses. ([investors.epam.com](https://investors.epam.com/news/news-details/2026/EPAM-Reports-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025/default.aspx))

Geopolitical disruptions (including Ukraine-related effects) impacting staffing, delivery, or risk profile. ([s202.q4cdn.com](https://s202.q4cdn.com/436759741/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/10k-2025.pdf))
